item.description: 网站专栏报告。作者: 智库研究员。这篇智库文章初次发表在19. Center for Eastern Studies (OSW) --Poland官方网站上。
item.content:encoded:
Ukrainian advances north of Lyman. Day 1651 of the war

发布源: 19. Center for Eastern Studies (OSW) --Poland | 抓取时间: 2026-09-05

Counterattacks by Ukrainian forces north of Lyman, combined with supply problems caused by drone strikes, have resulted in the withdrawal of some Russian forces from areas west of the Netryus River and, consequently, a reduction in the encirclement of Sloviansk from the north. Ukraine also regained control of some of the territory north and east of Sviatohirsk that had previously been lost or remained in a grey zone. The Russian flank remains at risk of being fragmented and cut off from the main forces, and consequently of being completely eliminated. Depending on the source, since July this year Ukrainian operationshave led to this area contracting by as much as 200 km2, with most of the territory abandoned by Russia now falling within the grey zone. Vasyl Denysiuk, spokesperson for the Ukrainian 66th Mechanised Brigade, reported that approximately 30% of Russian forces in the Lyman area are mercenaries.

Russian forces continued their advance east and south of the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk conurbation. According to some sources, they have captured Novoandriivka on the road running west from Druzhkivka, which threatens to outflank that town. The Russians have also reached the road linking Dobropillia with Kramatorsk, which significantly hinders the supply of the former (this is currently possible via a detour through Oleksandrivka).
